reusable_rules: A superclass method is attributable only when construction, a lifecycle callback, or a reachable virtual call invokes it; XML subtype discovery alone must not seed every relevant method.
Preserve one allocation identity while viewing it through BaseWebView/X5Wrapper/DtX5/smtt parent types; do not create a second object id for a parent helper call.

For `if (webView == null) webView = new DtX5WebView(...)`, keep the fallback allocation separate and require null feasibility; a preceding mandatory XML field write makes it infeasible on the normal lifecycle path.
Object-typed compatibility helpers must select the branch compatible with the bound receiver hierarchy; an X5Wrapper/BaseWebView cannot simultaneously be android.webkit.WebView.
Settings/client calls through a field/getter chain should inherit the XML allocation identity, not merely attach XML evidence to an unknown union.
